nodes.name: Issue Token
nodes.notes: Returns the RAW token (uuid) and stores only its SHA-256 hash on properties. Returns NULL when the property has zero pending_approval posts (nothing to approve) or does not exist. The function ALSO sets properties.status='ready' and clears approved_at/approved_by_ip atomically — so this workflow does NOT update status separately. The raw token in this node's output is why saveDataSuccessExecution=none is pinned on this workflow specifically.

nodes.name: Token Issued?
nodes.notes: The function returns one row with token=null when there is nothing to approve. Guard on the VALUE being non-empty, not on row count — the Postgres node returns a row either way. False branch stops silently: no pending posts is a normal state, not an error.

nodes.name: Load Property + Posts

parameters.query:
select
  p.title,
  p.municipality,
  p.canton,
  p.rooms,
  p.living_area_m2,
  p.price,
  a.full_name as agent_name,
  a.email     as agent_email,
  coalesce(a.locale, p.locale, 'de-CH') as locale,
  (
    select jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object('platform', po.platform, 'caption', po.caption)
             order by po.platform
           )
      from public.posts po
     where po.property_id = p.id
       and po.status = 'pending_approval'
  ) as posts
from public.properties p
join public.agents a on a.id = p.agent_id
where p.id = $1::uuid;

nodes.notes: property_id is pulled from the trigger, not from the previous node — the IF branch only carries { token }, not property_id. n8n_worker has SELECT on properties, posts, and agents. Fetches the agent's email as the recipient and every pending caption for the body.

nodes.name: Send Approval Email
nodes.notes: The raw token is pulled directly from Issue Token here and interpolated into the Approve/Reject URLs — it never passed through a Set or Code node. BASE points at the 04 Edge Function, which is not built yet: REPLACE_WITH_APPROVAL_FUNCTION is a placeholder. The links are GET URLs; 04 MUST render a confirmation page on GET and mutate only on POST, or mail-scanner prefetch publishes everything on delivery. Recipient is the agent's own email.
